name: agent-upgrade
title: Agent-run upgrade
purpose: An agent works the upgrade of a venture (U-3, I-29): the framework's migrations run on a copy, the agent does what the version guides leave to a person (prose such as AGENTS.md), and the framework's checks decide. Nothing lands until the checks pass and the founder types the confirmation.
use_model: the agent edits the staged copy by the version guides' by-hand steps
note: The agent sees only the staged copy, never _private/, and its claims are not trusted: every file it changed is found by hash and logged as an agent's write, and the framework's checks run after it. MENTURA_AGENT_CMD replaces the default agent (platform/kits/agent-upgrade/stand-in-agent.mjs is the offline stand-in the tests use).
